name: waabe-revit-readonly
description: Small read-only MCP bridge for Autodesk Revit 2023 and 2026.
long_description: A playground extension that reads the active Revit version and document metadata through a Revit add-in. It performs no Revit transactions and exposes no write tools.

tools.name: revit_get_document_info
tools.description: Read the connected Revit version, build and active-document metadata. Does not modify the model.

revit_year.title: Revit target year
revit_year.description: Choose the running Revit instance: 2023 or 2026.
